title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Document Extensions: Household-Letter Allowance for Benefit Letters and Zero-Income Attestations
content:
**Clause.** When the documents due date of a Patient Financial Assistance Program case is extended, a household-letter allowance is added to the extension's days before they are counted: a case with a Social Security benefit letter received adds the disability days, 3 days; a case with no such letter but a zero-income attestation received adds the no-income-member days, 2 days; any other case adds none.

| Received for the case | Allowance |
|---|---|
| A Social Security benefit letter (with or without a zero-income attestation) | 3 days |
| A zero-income attestation, no Social Security benefit letter | 2 days |
| Neither | None |

The allowance is read from the documents received for the case. Where both documents are on file, the letter governs and the allowance is 3 days, not 5.
